title: The 5 Biggest Cruise Ships Afloat, Ranked (All Five Belong to One Company)

scenes.text: The five biggest cruise ships on Earth, ranked. The top three are one ship, built three times.

description:
The five biggest cruise ships in service, ranked by gross tonnage.
Wonder of the Seas (2022, 235,600 GT) and Utopia of the Seas (2024, 236,473 GT) are the two largest Oasis-class ships. Above them sit the three Icon-class sisters, each 248,663 gross tons and 364 metres long with about 2,350 crew and up to 7,600 guests: Legend of the Seas (2026), Star of the Seas (2025) and the first of them, Icon of the Seas (2024), which can carry close to 10,000 people when full. All five are operated by Royal Caribbean.
Would you ever sail on a ship with 10,000 people, and what should we rank next?
